entities.summary: Luke Glendening is an American professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Philadelphia Flyers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He previously played in the NHL for the Detroit Red Wings, Dallas Stars, Tampa Bay Lightning, and New Jersey Devils.
